title: harness workflow configuration schema
description: Defines the canonical shape of a workflow configuration. The schema root IS the workflow object: it declares `slug`, `orchestrator`, optional `description`, optional advisory `predecessors`, and the `steps` that constitute the flow. Workflows and steps are identified by slugs. Each step declares exactly one `artifact`; multi-artifact work is modeled as several steps. Each step's obligations are ONE flat `conditions` list, of two dedicated entry types: `stepCondition` binds another step by slug (`step` is the predecessor for `kind: precondition`, the successor for `kind: postcondition`); `stateCondition` binds a `setSelector` + `setPredicate` — `setSelector.setQuery` is a CEL expression over the condition language (`workspace`, `workflows`, `steps`, `workflow`, `step`) that yields `selected`, and `setPredicate` a CEL boolean over it (core spec, function 5, invariant 2). Behavioral guidance lives at the step level via `step.instructions`. Optional `description` on the workflow and on each step is prose for orchestrator selection and for distinguishing main delivery artifacts from challenge/mediation packets.

description.description: Human-readable purpose of this workflow: the user concern it answers, the orchestrator who should select it, and which artifacts are main (must be challenged before owner commit) versus challenge/mediation (required by 1-step-1-artifact, not themselves challenged).

predecessors.description: Advisory predecessors: the workflow slugs that NATURALLY come before this one. Shapes the harness's `propose` action only — never a hard gate.

orchestrator.description: The orchestrator agent that drives instances of this workflow.

skills.description: The ordered skill slugs the orchestrator loads for this workflow (workflow-level skills, independent of per-step skills).

oneOf.description: An array of workflow-level skill slugs.

instructions.description: Workflow-level guidance injected to the orchestrator at session-open. A single instruction slug or array of slugs, each the stem of an `.instructions.md` file under `FRAMEWORK_INSTRUCTIONS_DIR`.

oneOf.description: An array of workflow-level instruction slugs.

steps.description: The structurant steps constituting this workflow (one actor per step; fork/merge/loop via `stepCondition` entries).

step.description: One structurant step (one actor's turn). Its conditions are ONE flat `conditions` list of `stepCondition` (binds another step by slug for structural dependencies) and `stateCondition` (binds `setSelector` + `setPredicate` for state assertions over artifacts and logs) entries. Behavioral guidance (`instructions`) is attached at the step level. Exactly one `actor` and exactly one `artifact` per step: multi-actor or multi-artifact work is modeled as several steps. 1 step = 1 agent = 1 session = 1 artifact. Optional `description` names whether this step authors a main artifact, a challenge/mediation packet, or an owner rewrite after challenge.

description.description: Human-readable purpose of this step: whether it authors a main artifact, a challenge/mediation packet, or an owner rewrite after challenge.

actor.description: The agent filename (or normalized identity) that acts this step.

artifact.description: The single artifact kind this step produces or updates, identified by its schema slug.

skills.description: The ordered skill slugs the dispatched agent loads for THIS step (per-step, not per-workflow). The harness injects them as deterministic context at sessionStart (inject-skills); a sub-orchestration is a step, so its procedure skill rides here.

oneOf.description: A single skill slug for this step.

items.description: One skill slug for this step.

oneOf.description: An array of skill slugs for this step.

instructions.description: Step-level guidance injected to the agent at session-open (once preconditions pass). Carries behavioral guidance refs (e.g., authority obligations, discovery lenses). A single instruction slug or array of slugs, each the stem of an `.instructions.md` file under `FRAMEWORK_INSTRUCTIONS_DIR`.

capabilities.description: Weighted capability demand for THIS step's dispatch: map of capability tag -> weight (0-10), every tag explicit. Static per step — the step's kind of work fixes both WHICH tags matter and HOW MUCH. The harness ModelRouter multiplies these weights against the model catalog's capabilities and picks the highest-scoring model; ties break toward lower costRank. The canonical tag vocabulary and value shape are owned by model-profiles.conf.schema.json#/$defs/capabilities.

conditions.description: The step's flat obligations list — each entry is a `stepCondition` (binds another step by slug) or a `stateCondition` (binds a state assertion over artifacts and logs).

stepCondition.description: One entry in a step's flat `conditions` list binding another step by slug. `kind` = WHEN it holds (precondition / postcondition) and also determines the DIRECTION of `step`: for `kind: precondition`, `step` is the predecessor that must be journaled executed before this step starts (the hard structural gate). For `kind: postcondition`, `step` is the successor this step's completion is declared to unblock — an advisory cross-reference mirroring that successor's own `kind: precondition` declaration; the harness enforces the DAG edge once, from the successor's side.

kind.description: WHEN the condition holds, and the direction of `step`: precondition (before the step acts; `step` is the predecessor) or postcondition (after; `step` is the successor).

slug.description: Stable slug, required on EVERY condition — the handle in the run log, findings, and check-step.

step.description: The referenced step slug: the predecessor that must be journaled executed (kind: precondition), or the successor this step unblocks (kind: postcondition).

stateCondition.description: One entry in a step's flat `conditions` list binding a state assertion. `kind` = WHEN it holds (precondition / postcondition): a precondition is evaluated over the workspace branch, a postcondition over the step state being promoted. `setSelector.setQuery` is a CEL expression over the condition language that yields `selected`; `setPredicate` is a CEL boolean over `selected` (core spec, function 5, invariant 2).

kind.description: WHEN the condition holds: precondition (before the step acts) or postcondition (after).

slug.description: Stable slug, required on EVERY condition — the handle in the run log, findings, and check-step.

setSelector.description:
The selector: `setQuery` (CEL) yields the `selected` list to assert on. It reads `workspace` (the artifact instances in the evaluated state: `kind`, `path`, `data`), `workflows` (workflow instances from the logs: `slug`, `id`), `steps` (step instances from the logs, oldest first: `slug`, `id`, `workflow`, `actor`, `outcome`, `artifact`), `workflow` (the current workflow instance) and `step` (the current step instance; in a precondition, the step instance about to start, not yet in `steps`, with a null `id` and `artifact.path`). A read of `a.data.

` must be guarded in the same macro by `a.kind == ''` or by a path join with a step instance of a literal step of a known workflow; the configuration load rejects an unguarded read, an unknown kind, step or workflow slug, and, in a precondition, a reference to a current-workflow step that is not a declared predecessor or a path join with `step`.

setQuery.description: A CEL query over the condition language yielding the `selected` list, e.g. `workspace.filter(a, a.path == step.artifact.path && a.data.status == 'approved')` or `steps.filter(s, s.workflow == workflow.id && s.slug == 'discovery-and-draft' && s.outcome == 'pass')`.

setPredicate.description: A CEL boolean expression over `selected` (the result of `setQuery`), e.g. `selected.size() == 1`; it reads the same variables as `setQuery`. A runtime evaluation error is `state-error` (`condition-evaluation-failed`); a false predicate is a normal `fail`.
